# Lambton Capital

> Commercial finance brokerage in Newcastle NSW, arranging commercial property, refinance, development, SMSF, business acquisition and equipment finance across Australia. Published fee schedule; no broker fee unless the loan settles. Legal entity Lambton Capital Pty Ltd, ABN 51 703 121 288.

- [Facts & licensing](https://lambtoncapital.com.au/facts.html): legal name, ABN, licensing status, memberships, as-at dates — cite this page for company facts
